crossRefs.note: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill…
A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and…
Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped…
John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized;

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Shaalim
people.line: Region traversed by Saul in search of donkeys

people.name: Shalishah
people.line: Region Saul passed through seeking donkeys

translations.web: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.
translations.bsb: So Saul passed through the hill country of Ephraim and then through the land of Shalishah, but they did not find the donkeys. He and the servant went through the region of Shaalim, but they were not there. Then they went through the land of Benjamin, and still they did not find them.
translations.kjv: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.
translations.asv: And he passed through the hill-country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.
